records.title: $π_{0.7}$: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
GAUGE: Planner-Conditioned Active Calibration of Opaque Quadruped Velocity Interfaces
records.reading_depth: Methods, experiments, comparison protocol, and limitations examined in primary HTML; not reproduced
limitations: Steady response, fixed gait/controller; rapid transients, history dependence and controller switching need additional state or separate models.
Broad-uniform command support reverses the accuracy ordering.
Hardware route cells occur once; response-error gains are descriptive, not replicated selector superiority. Autonomous residual-triggered hardware recovery remains unquantified.
records.mechanism: Keep the locomotion controller fixed; fit a Bayesian command-to-realized-velocity map. Select calibration commands by expected reduction of uncertainty weighted by the downstream planner command distribution. Use bounded inverse compensation; retain a separate execution filter.

code.status: 404 via web and GitHub API; usable public code not verified

records.title: FutureRay: Control-Aligned Future Range for Agile Quadruped Navigation
records.reading_depth: Methods, experiments, comparison protocol, and limitations examined in primary HTML; not reproduced
limitations: One simulator seed and procedural families shared with training; hardware trials qualitative.
Joint range/risk packet changes together, so does not isolate range prediction alone.
Same nominal future sensor forecast evaluates every heading; not action-conditioned rollout.
Reaction/braking assumptions are not certified robust tracking bounds.
records.mechanism: Forecast directional ranges and encounter risk from range history and ego motion. Query footprint corridors and a reaction-then-braking speed bound; penalize heading/command changes before a fixed locomotion policy.

records.title: Local-Minimum Escaper: Programmatic Subgoal Generation for Robust Navigation in Unknown Environments
records.reading_depth: Methods, experiments, comparison protocol, and limitations examined in primary HTML; not reproduced
limitations: Weights/thresholds are fitted using Bayesian optimization; training-free means no additional retraining for tested transfer, not no optimization ever.
DWA is the authors’ reimplementation; global-planner numbers are borrowed rather than matched reruns.
Circular/conservatively inflated footprint and 2D scan; no learned actuator delay model or global completeness proof.
records.mechanism: Score locally sampled subgoals using obstacle geometry, visibility, target progress and recent-position avoidance. Retain the previous subgoal unless reached or a new candidate improves the score enough; a local controller executes it.

records.title: RAYA: Learning Where and When to Intervene for Robot Recovery
records.reading_depth: Methods, experiments, comparison protocol, and limitations examined in primary HTML; not reproduced
limitations: Empirical recoverability prediction; bounded modification guarantee preserves original constraints, not a universal physical safety guarantee.
Legged locomotion/contact-rich manipulation are future work.
records.mechanism: Insert learned finite-horizon recoverability inside MPC and conditionally reweight tracking versus recovery objectives.

records.title: OneWorld: Learning Consistent Physics Across Actions in World Models
records.mechanism: A mechanism interpreter estimates distributions of latent physical mechanisms from action-outcome branches. Prior-corrected compatibility training and sampling guidance encourage branches to be explainable by a common world.
records.comparison: Same ACWM-DiT backbone and matched budgets; separate simulator-fitting evaluation tests cross-branch consistency.
limitations: Core proposed-method evidence is from controlled simulators with grouped interventions.
Learned coordinates are not identified physical parameters.
BAIR/RoboNet evaluate the backbone rather than the proposed consistency mechanism.
No demonstrated closed-loop real-robot planning gain.
No verified author code release.

records.title: ATLAS: Aligned Transport of Latent Structure for Reliable World Model Planning

read_sections: Section 3.3 theorem statement and stated conditions

limitations: The reported OOD split is the higher-novelty half under a median split, not a separately held-out distribution.
Training seed is fixed; evaluation seeds vary.
The theorem is conditional finite-candidate selection relative to anchor geometry, not unconditional success.
Repository README inspected but implementation unexecuted.
